# Follow-up brief (radar + closeness bars). Do NOT edit src/data or research/. Impeccable skill, neutral copy. pnpm build + validate must pass. No commit/push.
On Compare, per contest, above the "Closest to your answers" list, add:
(a) An SVG radar chart component (src/components/ContestRadar.tsx, no new chart lib). One spoke per issue the user ANSWERED in that contest with stance not null (skip unanswered/no-opinion). Axis labels = short issue names (truncate/wrap; readable at 390px). Map stance -2..+2 to radius in a way that keeps all values >0 radius (e.g. r = (v+3)/5 of max) and label the scale ends per spoke with the issue's left/right labels in a tooltip or legend. Draw the user's polygon (distinct, on top) plus each candidate polygon in distinct colorblind-safe non-party colors (no red/blue party association). Legend with toggle chips to show/hide each candidate. Unknown candidate positions: break the polygon segment (draw as separate polylines) and show a hollow point at center ring marked "unknown" — never as zero/middle. Party-assumed: dashed line, only when the party toggle is on (otherwise treated as unknown).
If fewer than 3 answered issues: don't draw radar; show the per-issue horizontal dot lines (reuse IssuePositionChart/MiniPositionChart) with a note "Answer at least 3 issues in this race to see the radar view."
(b) Directly under it, a horizontal closeness bar per candidate using the importance-weighted score from src/lib/compare.ts, with coverage note ("Based on 3 of 5 issues you answered · 2 unknown") and "Not enough info" state (greyed, unranked). Neutral wording: "Closest match to your answers".
Mobile-friendly: radar max-width 100%, legend wraps.

## Also: race filter + grouping (keep scope tight)
- Explore: toggle "Group by: Category | Ballot race" (persist in localStorage `bevg.settings.v1`). Race filter = multi-select chips of contests that have issues (persist `raceFilter: string[]`, empty = all). Only questions whose contestIds intersect the filter are shown; "Question X of N", jump list and progress counts reflect the filtered set.
- My Views: same race filter chips (shared persisted state); header counts reflect filtered set.
